answer: Random audit with slashing: every epoch the chain picks 5% of mining keys by verifiable lottery and asks each to answer a fresh live challenge within minutes. The farm operator pays: each fake must hold its own stake and a working agent, since one key failing an audit loses its whole bond, so cost grows linearly per fake and risk compounds with fleet size. A sybil forge cannot hide on some quiet knoll of idle keys. Failure case: an attacker who answers audits by routing them to one model gets caught by timing overlap, a karst of shared latency under every key.
